[Unit]
Description=Qisutu Automation and Mail Daemon (qisutu)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=qisutu
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/opt/qisutu
Environment=QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu
ExecStart=/usr/bin/perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl --sleep 3 --max-jobs 100
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=120
KillSignal=SIGTERM
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Finalize Qisutu installation (qisutu)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl enable --now qisutu-daemon.service
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl disable --now qisutu-install-complete.path
ExecStart=/bin/rm -f /etc/systemd/system/qisutu-install-complete.path /etc/systemd/system/qisutu-install-complete.service
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl daemon-reload

[Unit]
Description=Watch for completed Qisutu web installation (qisutu)

[Path]
PathExists=/opt/qisutu/var/install/installed.lock
Unit=qisutu-install-complete.service

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
